description: This file contains unit tests for the Cron scheduling and payload functionalities within the OpenClaw project. It defines test cases for encoding/decoding cron schedules and payloads, verifying behaviors such as handling legacy formats, error cases, and data integrity. Additionally, it includes helper functions to create test CronJob instances and assertions to verify computed properties like display names and last run times.

classes.name: CronModelsTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for cron-related models and functionalities, ensuring correct encoding/decoding and behavior of scheduling components.

methods.name: makeCronJob
methods.description: Helper function to create a CronJob instance with specified name, payload text, and optional state for testing purposes.
